svg.title: Azure Databricks turns streaming and operational data into governed analytics
svg.desc: Modern analytics with Azure Databricks, after the Azure Architecture Center pattern

text.tspan: Azure Databricks turns streaming and operational data into governed analytics
Modern analytics with Azure Databricks, after the Azure Architecture Center pattern
Declarative pipelines read streaming events from
Event Hubs and orders from Azure SQL Database.
Raw records land as bronze Delta tables in ADLS
Pipelines conform them into silver tables and
Power BI queries the gold tables through a
Models tracked in MLflow are deployed with Azure
Unity Catalog governs every table, with lineage
and quality monitoring across the estate.
